verdict.rationale: Ollama markets itself as the 'easiest way to run open AI models locally' with instant model switching and cloud fallback (ollama-docs-8, ollama-probe-1), and some users report solid token throughput after startup (ollama-comm-3), but other community reports describe very slow startup/inference and hidden configuration that prevents keeping models resident in memory, undercutting cold-start speed claims (ollama-comm-10, ollama-comm-13, ollama-comm-2).
